$comment: Third-party code and binaries that reach PiArc's release artefacts without a package manager, so Cargo and npm metadata cannot list them (architecture section 10.4).
T50's scripts/release/gen-notices.mjs reads this file, together with the Cargo and npm dependency trees, to generate THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES. Every entry names its license text in this repository.
Add an entry in the same change that vendors code or links a prebuilt binary.

components.name: libghostty-vt
components.usedBy: crates/piarc-ghostty-sys: linked statically into the macOS Core module; ghostty-vt.dll ships next to the Windows Core module
components.notes: The library bundles simdutf, Highway and Wuffs (permissive licenses, no copyleft; docs/research/terminal-libghostty.md section 1.1). T50 checks their license texts against the release's source tarball when generating the notices.

components.name: ghostty-web CanvasRenderer (fork)
components.usedBy: apps/desktop/src/renderer/terminal/vendor/ghostty-web/renderer.ts (modified; changes listed in README.md next to it)

components.name: OpenAI Codex Seatbelt base policy
components.usedBy: crates/piarc-sandbox/src/seatbelt/base.sbpl (copied unmodified after a PiArc header comment; compiled into the Core module with include_str!)
components.notes: Codex's NOTICE reads "OpenAI Codex / Copyright 2025 OpenAI" (its Ratatui note concerns code PiArc does not use); T50 reproduces it in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.

components.name: Node.js runtime (node, npm, npx)
components.license: MIT AND others (see the licence file: Node.js bundles npm and third-party code under their own permissive licences)
components.copyright: Copyright Node.js contributors. All rights reserved.
components.usedBy: Resources/agent-host/node/ of the packaged app: runs the Agent Host and the MCP servers it starts (ADR-0015); node keeps the Node.js Foundation signature on macOS
components.notes: Only bin/node, bin/npm, bin/npx, lib/node_modules/npm and LICENSE ship (node.exe, npm, npx and node_modules/npm on Windows); headers, docs and corepack are left out by scripts/dev/fetch-binaries.mjs.

components.name: ripgrep (rg)
components.usedBy: Resources/agent-host/bin/rg: preinstalled so Pi never downloads it at run time (ADR-0015 rule 7); ad-hoc signed on macOS

components.name: fd
components.usedBy: Resources/agent-host/bin/fd: preinstalled so Pi never downloads it at run time (ADR-0015 rule 7); ad-hoc signed on macOS

components.name: Velopack installer and Update.exe
components.copyright: Copyright © 2021 Caelan Sayler; Copyright © 2024 Velopack Ltd.
components.usedBy: Windows installers built by vpk pack: Setup.exe and the Update.exe it installs next to PiArc (the npm package velopack, the main-process binding, is covered by npm metadata)

components.name: Pi (earendil-works/pi) source ported into PiArc
components.usedBy: agent-host/src/tools/paths.ts and grep.ts (bundled into agent-host.mjs); crates/piarc-fs/src/image.rs (compiled into the Core module). Each file's header names the functions it ports and what changed.
components.notes: Pi itself is an npm dependency and is listed from the npm tree; this entry covers only the code ported at source level. agent-host/src/runtime/credentials.test.ts adapts Pi's tests but does not ship.

components.name: Pi mark (thesvg.org icon)
components.usedBy: design/brand/mark.svg, source of menu bar and tray icons (T35, T50)
components.notes: The licence covers the SVG file only, not the Pi name or logo as trademarks; see design/brand/README.md (requirement D3).
